shots.name: gate
shots.prompt: Vertical phone-format photo, subject centred in the middle of the frame with space above and below. A smart, good-looking Nigerian estate security guard in a neat dark uniform and cap stands at the barrier of a gated Abuja estate gatehouse, glancing at his phone with a calm, friendly half-smile. Painted gatehouse, barrier arm and palms behind. Warm morning light. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: guest
shots.prompt: Vertical phone-format photo, subject centred in the middle of the frame with space above and below. A cheerful, well-dressed young Nigerian woman arrives at the pedestrian gate of a gated Lagos estate, showing her phone to the guard off-frame and smiling. Gatehouse wall, potted plants and palms behind. Bright daylight. Phone screen facing away from camera.
